context: Tatsuya shows Sho around the country town.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: しょう、この町、本当、いい所だ。
lines.en: Sho — this town is truly a good place.
lines.style: Slow, unhurried opening. Warm rural timbre, low and grounded. Settles weight on 'good place' with quiet conviction. Gentle, real affection woven through — not performed, just present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yes — I really like it. I really do.
lines.style: Small, soft voice with genuine warmth underneath. Gentle agreement that carries real feeling. Slight emphasis on the second 'really' — not to convince, just to confirm sincerity.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 皆、本当、優しい、人、ばかり。
lines.en: Everyone here — truly, they're all just kind people.
lines.style: Contemplative and slow. Rural composure grounded in the voice. Observational rather than flattering. A quiet philosophical certainty about human goodness, delivered without flourish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Being together like this — it's truly fun.
lines.style: Small, bright voice. Real delight without performance. Soft warmth on 'together' — the togetherness itself is what matters. A child's simple contentment made genuine.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Gentle invitation, unhurried. Quiet persistence in the request — not demanding, just inviting. Warm rural patience threading through. The door is open, no urgency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'll try hard — I really will. I promise.
lines.style: Small, earnest voice with quiet determination. Bright beneath the sincerity. Child's commitment made clear without strain — a genuine promise held carefully.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Deep, closing gratitude. Slow and weighted. Rural warmth settling into something tender and final. Sincere depth without sentimentality. A man expressing true thanks.
